approval.value: `--permission-prompts none` in print mode denies anything that would prompt, while the configured permission mode still decides other calls (help). Preferred narrow candidate; it can refuse work requiring approval and has no fallback to permission bypass.

sandbox_linux.value: Help does not prove Linux OS containment or whether configured hooks affect it. sandbox_macos.value: Help does not prove macOS OS containment. Do not pass sandbox overrides or `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Iteration 08 must confirm the vendor settings.json sandbox keys, availability and macOS enforcement on a native Mac.
